content:
anya: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: API / Console / Optimize timelines — dropping the clarifications and action items here.
kevin: thanks — first Q: streaming GA for hosted API? we heard 'soon' but need dates to plan migrations.
maria: also need to know SDK parity for streaming (python/js).
anya: short answers: beta rolling next 2 weeks, GA targeted mid-Q3. SDK parity: python SDK will have streaming at beta start; js SDK GA a few weeks after.
alex: are there perf SLOs for streaming GA? e.g., p95 < 250ms for short responses?
anya: yes — target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for 0-128 tokens on dedicated/hosted. exact SLOs in the release doc.
jeff: where can engineers find the rollout playbook / canary config?
release-bot: Draft rollout playbook uploaded to Confluence — https://redwood.internal/confluence/streams-rollout (edit access: eng, product) :link:
dana: for Console UI changes (routes, model picker) — what's the freeze window before GA?
maria: Console freeze = 72 hours for last UI changes, 1 week for infra toggles. we'll communicate patch windows.
anke: (typo)
anya: action items: @kevin validate e2e tests for streaming by next Tues, @maria coordinate SDK release notes, @alex run perf suite on dedicated cluster and post results. I'll sync with infra on canary capacity.
kevin: on it.
maria: noted, will draft PR and changelog.
alex: schedule spike for perf tests today, will post results in #eng-runtime.
anya: last note — Optimize features (batching suggestions and quantization advisor) timeline: public beta end of month, GA ~6 weeks later. docs and cost impact examples incoming.
jeff: will we get cost delta estimates per model size? that would help product prioritization.
anya: yes — Optimize will include model-specific cost projections in the Console UI (example numbers for small/medium/large).
release-bot: Reminder: please sign off on the pre-GA checklist in Confluence by EOD Friday.
anya: thanks everyone. I'll post the consolidated schedule + a short changelog here in the morning. :thumbsup:
